area.eternalrealm.arcelia.desc: Gentle meadows south of the capital. Over the windmill hill, every adventure begins here.
area.eternalrealm.elder_forest.desc: A deep forest where moonlight spills through the leaves. Maddened spores and vines turn intruders away.
area.eternalrealm.sandria_desert.desc: The iron mine that keeps the kingdom running. At the bottom of the quarry, a sand-buried sun temple was dug up.
area.eternalrealm.nordia_snowfield.desc: A great waterfall that seems to fall from heaven. Out-of-season ice spreads over the plateau above, where an ice castle stands.
area.eternalrealm.dragonia_volcano.desc: The temple ruins of an ancient kingdom on a hill. Deep beneath them, dragon fire smoulders.
area.eternalrealm.celestia.desc: Silver peaks piercing the clouds. Above the summit drift the floating ruins of an ancient people.
area.eternalrealm.tower_of_the_end.desc: A forest stained by violet miasma. At its heart rises the black tower where the King of the End waits.

quest.eternalrealm.m1_arrival.desc: Meet the knight captain of Arcelia and enlist as an adventurer.
quest.eternalrealm.m1_hunt.desc: Thin out the meadow slimes and wandering dead overrunning the plains.
quest.eternalrealm.m1_dungeon.desc: Descend into the old city beneath the capital and find the bandits' hideout.
quest.eternalrealm.m1_boss.desc: Defeat the Bandit King deep in the undercity and open the road to the forest.
quest.eternalrealm.m2_arrival.desc: Enter the Moonshadow Forest and hear of the disturbance from the sage.
quest.eternalrealm.m2_hunt.desc: Slay the frenzied forest spiders and witches to calm the woods.
quest.eternalrealm.m2_dungeon.desc: Fight through the labyrinth deep within the roots of the ancient tree.
quest.eternalrealm.m2_boss.desc: Subdue the maddened guardian of the ancient tree and open the way to the mine.
quest.eternalrealm.m3_arrival.desc: Reach the Ironvein Mine and hear the caravan master's rumors of the temple.
quest.eternalrealm.m3_hunt.desc: Hunt the sand husks and giant scarabs that raid the caravans.
quest.eternalrealm.m3_dungeon.desc: Brave the buried temple and reach its innermost chamber.
quest.eternalrealm.m3_boss.desc: Defeat the Colossus of the Sandstorm and open the way north.
quest.eternalrealm.m4_arrival.desc: Reach the Sacred Falls and ask the Nordia chieftain for help.
quest.eternalrealm.m4_hunt.desc: Defeat the frozen dead and snowfield archers threatening the village.
quest.eternalrealm.m4_dungeon1.desc: Infiltrate the ice-locked prison and learn what became of its captives.
quest.eternalrealm.m4_boss1.desc: Defeat the executioner who rules the frozen prison.
quest.eternalrealm.m4_dungeon2.desc: Conquer the frozen castle on the plateau above the falls.
quest.eternalrealm.m4_boss2.desc: Defeat the queen who brings eternal winter and open the way to the Ancient Ruins.
quest.eternalrealm.m5_arrival.desc: Reach the Ancient Ruins and meet the dragonforge smith.
quest.eternalrealm.m5_hunt.desc: Hunt lava slimes and crater blazes to secure the road to the forge.
quest.eternalrealm.m5_dungeon.desc: Conquer the searing cave where the Dragon King sleeps.
quest.eternalrealm.m5_boss.desc: Defeat the awakened Dragon King and open the way to the sky.
quest.eternalrealm.m6_arrival.desc: Reach the Soaring Peaks and receive the oracle's revelation.
quest.eternalrealm.m6_hunt.desc: Defeat the cloud phantoms and sky archers.
quest.eternalrealm.m6_dungeon.desc: Conquer the ruins of the ancient civilization and find the Machine God.
quest.eternalrealm.m6_boss.desc: Stop the rampaging Machine God and open the way to the Tower of the End.
quest.eternalrealm.m7_arrival.desc: Reach the Tower of the End and hear of the final battle from the tower watcher.
quest.eternalrealm.m7_hunt.desc: Defeat the void wanderers and knights of the end guarding the tower.
quest.eternalrealm.m7_dungeon.desc: Climb the tower toward the gate of the king's hall.
quest.eternalrealm.m7_boss.desc: Defeat the Gatekeeper of the End guarding the king's hall.
quest.eternalrealm.m7_final.desc: Join forces with the whole server and bring down the King of the End.
quest.eternalrealm.s1_slime_gel.desc: Collect meadow slime gel for the item shop.
quest.eternalrealm.s2_forest_spores.desc: Defeat vine creepers and gather forest spores for medicine.
quest.eternalrealm.s3_tomb_warden.desc: Defeat the tomb warden and bring back desert crystals.
quest.eternalrealm.s4_yeti_hunt.desc: Hunt snowfield yetis and gather their fur.
quest.eternalrealm.s5_drake_scales.desc: Defeat a dragonkin berserker and gather drake scales.
quest.eternalrealm.s6_star_fragments.des: Defeat a celestial paladin and gather star fragments.

dialogue.eternalrealm.sandria_caravan_ma: You crossed the sea of sand? If it's the temple you're after, no one knows more than us caravaners.
dialogue.eternalrealm.nordia_chieftain.g: This winter will not end. Since the queen awoke, our village only grows colder.

story.eternalrealm.chapter.prologue.titl: Prologue: Call of the Star Gate
story.eternalrealm.chapter.prologue.syno: On the night the black moon rose, Princess Lilia performed the Rite of Summoning and called adventurers from another world.
story.eternalrealm.chapter.1.title: Chapter 1: The Capital Below
story.eternalrealm.chapter.1.synopsis: Beneath the capital lies the old city that sank long ago. Laszlo the Bandit King, who nests there, is said to have found a black crystal.
story.eternalrealm.chapter.2.title: Chapter 2: The Ancient Tree Weeps
story.eternalrealm.chapter.2.synopsis: The Moonshadow Forest is withering. A black crystal has been eating away at the heart of the Ancient Tree's guardian.
story.eternalrealm.chapter.3.title: Chapter 3: Prayers Returned to Sand
story.eternalrealm.chapter.3.synopsis: At the bottom of the Ironvein Mine, a sun temple returned to sand has been found. The Order of Twilight seeks to awaken the Colossus of the Sandstorm.
story.eternalrealm.chapter.4.title: Chapter 4: Chains of the Silver Wolf
story.eternalrealm.chapter.4.synopsis: Above the Sacred Falls lies Nordia, an old kingdom sealed in a thousand-year winter. In the Frozen Prison, an executioner awaits intruders.
story.eternalrealm.chapter.5.title: Chapter 5: The Queen's Frozen Heart
story.eternalrealm.chapter.5.synopsis: On the throne of the Frozen Castle, Queen Ingrid keeps her thousand-year winter.
story.eternalrealm.chapter.6.title: Chapter 6: Wings of the Dragon King
story.eternalrealm.chapter.6.synopsis: Deep beneath the Ancient Ruins, the dragons of Dragonia rage. Calm the Dragon King's fury and open the way to the sky.
story.eternalrealm.chapter.7.title: Chapter 7: The Eternity Engine
story.eternalrealm.chapter.7.synopsis: Celestia, the sky city floating above the Soaring Peaks. In the ruins of the Sky Folk, a Machine God guards the order of eternity.
story.eternalrealm.chapter.8.title: Chapter 8: The Thousand-Year Gate
story.eternalrealm.chapter.8.synopsis: A gatekeeper has guarded the Tower of the End for a thousand years. But who is he...?
story.eternalrealm.chapter.finale.title: Finale: The King of the End
story.eternalrealm.chapter.finale.synops: Under the black full moon, the King of the End awaits on his throne. Gather ten or more allies for the final battle.
story.eternalrealm.chapter.epilogue.syno: The End has passed, and morning has come to Astoria. And now, the fourteenth night draws near.
story.eternalrealm.prologue.1: In a whirl of light, you hear someone calling.
story.eternalrealm.prologue.2: Please... please, let my voice reach them...!
story.eternalrealm.prologue.3: You open your eyes in a stone hall where star-shaped sigils glow.
story.eternalrealm.prologue.4: Thank goodness...! The Rite of Summoning worked.
story.eternalrealm.prologue.5: Welcome to Astoria. I am Lilia, Princess of the Kingdom of Arcelia.
story.eternalrealm.prologue.6: Forgive me for calling you so suddenly. But this world is running out of time.
story.eternalrealm.prologue.7: Do you see the black tower on the horizon? That is the Tower of the End.
story.eternalrealm.prologue.8: In fourteen days, on the night the black moon is full, the King of the End will awaken.
story.eternalrealm.prologue.9: Anyone born in this world vanishes at the End's touch. But you, who come from another world...
story.eternalrealm.prologue.10: ...can fight it. That's the long and short of it.
story.eternalrealm.prologue.11: Master Nox! This is the kingdom's scholar, Nox the Stargazer.
story.eternalrealm.prologue.12: ...So we meet again. Never mind. I was talking to myself.
story.eternalrealm.prologue.13: First, please call on Adel, Captain of the Knights. She will help you.
story.eternalrealm.prologue.14: Fourteen days to change the fate of the world.
story.eternalrealm.area.arcelia.title: Meadow of Beginnings
story.eternalrealm.area.arcelia.subtitle: Below the Star Gate capital, where adventure begins
story.eternalrealm.area.arcelia.enter.1: Beyond the hill where a windmill turns rises the white-walled capital.
story.eternalrealm.area.arcelia.enter.2: Above its gates, banners bearing a star crest flutter in the wind.
story.eternalrealm.area.elder_forest.sub: A whispering wood watched over by the Ancient Tree
story.eternalrealm.area.elder_forest.ent: A deep forest where moonlight pools in the shadows. Yet many of its leaves have withered to gray.
From deep within, the wind sounds almost like weeping.
story.eternalrealm.area.elder_forest.unl: Oh ho, my crown has returned! Well done, one and all!
The road to the Moonshadow Forest is open! The sage of the forest is waiting for you.
story.eternalrealm.area.sandria_desert.s: Beneath the shafts sleeps a sun temple returned to sand
story.eternalrealm.area.sandria_desert.e: From the quarry walls jut the pillars of an old temple, buried in sand.
The miners whisper that this was once the bottom of the sea.
story.eternalrealm.area.sandria_desert.u: The road to the Ironvein Mine is open!
The shafts are pitch dark even at noon. Don't forget a light and water!
story.eternalrealm.area.nordia_snowfield: Heaven's water, half frozen by a thousand-year winter
On the plateau above the great falls, an ice castle glows pale blue.
Even the spray of the falls drifts down here as snow.
The checkpoint to the Sacred Falls is open!
...Above the falls, huh. Watch yourselves. That's where my partner vanished.
story.eternalrealm.area.dragonia_volcano: A temple hill where dragon roars thunder from below
The flagstones of the fallen temple are warm; deep below, the earth pulses red.
A roar full of rage rides the scorching wind.
The road to the Ancient Ruins is open!
Ruins where a dragon sleeps! Why, in my youth I wrestled a dragon myself...
Father. You are not riding out.
Your Majesty. Please take off the armor.
story.eternalrealm.area.celestia.title: Soaring Peaks
story.eternalrealm.area.celestia.subtitl: A city above the clouds, left behind by the Sky Folk
story.eternalrealm.area.celestia.enter.1: Above peaks that pierce the clouds, islands of earth drift in the sky.
story.eternalrealm.area.celestia.enter.2: This was once the city of a people who feared endings.
story.eternalrealm.area.celestia.unlocke: The dragons have opened a way to the summit!
Celestia, the city in the sky... It has been a long time.
story.eternalrealm.area.tower_of_the_end: Where a king wakes from a thousand-year sleep
A violet miasma shrouds the forest, and beyond it a black tower pierces the heavens.
From deep inside comes a sound like a beating heart.
With seven crystals purified, the black mist shrouding the tower begins to clear.
The way to the Forest of the End... is open.
The last crystal lies with the tower's gatekeeper. ...Go.
story.eternalrealm.dungeon.d1.enter.1: Beneath the broken paving stones sleeps another capital.
story.eternalrealm.dungeon.d1.enter.3: Something groans low in the darkness.
story.eternalrealm.dungeon.d2.enter.1: Giant roots twist together, branching like a maze.
story.eternalrealm.dungeon.d2.enter.2: From the depths comes a creaking, wooden moan.
story.eternalrealm.dungeon.d3.enter.1: A sea temple buried in sand. Waves and fish are carved into its walls.
story.eternalrealm.dungeon.d3.enter.2: The End is salvation... the End is salvation...
story.eternalrealm.dungeon.d4.enter.1: Only the clank of chains echoes through the frozen halls.
story.eternalrealm.dungeon.d4.enter.2: In the cells, people lie sealed in ice.
story.eternalrealm.dungeon.d5.enter.1: In a hall made of ice, snow falls without a sound.
story.eternalrealm.dungeon.d6.enter.1: Rivers of lava light the cave a burning red.
story.eternalrealm.dungeon.d6.enter.2: From within comes breathing like the rumble of an earthquake.
story.eternalrealm.dungeon.d7.enter.1: In the white stone halls, ancient machines are still running.
story.eternalrealm.dungeon.d8.enter.1: Inside the tower, a black spiral staircase winds on without end.
story.eternalrealm.dungeon.d8.enter.2: With every step, the sounds of the world grow fainter.
story.eternalrealm.dungeon.final.enter.1: Beneath the black full moon, the throne room lies in utter silence.
story.eternalrealm.dungeon.final.enter.2: The figure on the throne slowly opens its eyes.
story.eternalrealm.boss.b1.intro.1: Welcome, otherworld brats! This is MY kingdom!
story.eternalrealm.boss.b1.intro.2: The crown, this black stone — it's all mine!
story.eternalrealm.boss.b1.intro.3: ...Huh, the stone's getting warm. Eh, whatever! Come and get me!
story.eternalrealm.boss.b1.defeat.1: W-wait! I give up, I give up!
W-wait, wait! I surrender! I'll give back the crown — I'll give back everything!
A black crystal tumbles from the Bandit King's coat and shatters without a sound.
Light rises from the shards, and a distant memory unfolds across the skies of Astoria.
Thank you for coming. ...What is your name?
A Star Memory... The Hall of the Star Gate, a thousand years ago.
More black crystals sleep across the land. Purify every one of them.
story.eternalrealm.boss.b2.intro.2: ...Deep in my chest... something black... it hurts...
story.eternalrealm.boss.b2.intro.3: ...All who approach... I will cast out...!
...I thank you, children of another world. It was a long nightmare.
Your eyes... they remind me of the oath sworn that day.
The crystal's light rises skyward. A thousand years ago, four figures stood beneath the Ancient Tree.
Here we swear: until the day we strike down the End, we shall never part.
I swear it. ...We will all go home together.
Oaths aren't really my thing... but fine, I'm in.
With the four of us, we'll be fine.
The Ancient Tree bursts into bloom, and the forest begins to breathe again.
story.eternalrealm.boss.b2.phase3: ...I must protect... this tree, at least...!
story.eternalrealm.boss.b3.intro.1: Welcome, lost children of another world. The End is salvation.
story.eternalrealm.boss.b3.intro.2: Pain, partings, sorrow. When all things end, no one will ever weep again.
story.eternalrealm.boss.b3.intro.3: Awaken, Colossus of the Sandstorm! Sing the gospel of the End!
story.eternalrealm.boss.b3.defeat.1: The Colossus crumbles into the sand, and silence returns to the temple.
The Colossus...! Why do you refuse the End...?
The King in the tower weeps in our dreams. 'End it,' he begs...
Light rises from the broken crystal, and another distant memory fills the sky.
The Star Gate's pact lasts fourteen days. When the black moon is full, you'll go home.
Fourteen days is plenty. I'll finish everything and go home with a smile.
...It's a promise, then. That you'll go home.
story.eternalrealm.boss.b3.phase2: Sands, swallow these children of another world!
story.eternalrealm.boss.b3.phase3: Colossus, bring the storm! End everything!
story.eternalrealm.boss.b4.intro.1: ...One who would end the winter. Your guilt is plain.
story.eternalrealm.boss.b4.intro.2: In the name of Her Majesty the Queen, you are condemned.
The frozen helm cracks apart, and a silver-haired man sinks to his knees.
I'm Wolfram. ...Is that oaf Gustav still alive?
The crystal's light rises, and a distant memory spreads across the snowy sky.
Kanata. I will guard your back. Whatever may come.
Then I'll clear the way ahead of you, Glaus.
...Trusting someone with your back, huh. That one stings.
story.eternalrealm.boss.b4.phase2: You won't escape. My chains reach everywhere.
story.eternalrealm.boss.b5.intro.1: So, otherworlder, you have come to end my winter.
story.eternalrealm.boss.b5.intro.2: Should this heart thaw, the north will be swallowed by the End. ...I will not allow it.
...Warm. The ice in my heart is melting.
A thousand years... What was I so afraid of?
The crystal's light rises, and a distant memory shines above the ice castle.
Child of another world. I shall seal the End's chill within my own heart.
A queen is one who bears her people's winter. ...Go.
Tell that boy for me: at last, I have seen spring.
The snows of Nordia begin to melt, and the first spring wind in a thousand years blows.
story.eternalrealm.boss.b5.phase3: I shall grant you the sleep of absolute zero.
story.eternalrealm.boss.b6.intro.1: Is it you who disturb my slumber, little ones?
story.eternalrealm.boss.b6.intro.2: The flame within me whispers: burn it all!
story.eternalrealm.boss.b6.defeat.1: Well fought, little one. I shall remember your fangs.
...My head has cooled. I thank you, little heroes.
Those eyes... I saw them a thousand years ago. The same eyes as that boy.
The crystal's light rises, and a distant memory burns across the sky.
Please, Dragon King! Take us up to the sky!
A whelp asking favors of a dragon? ...Very well. Climb on.
We dragons shall open the way to the sky. ...Go.
story.eternalrealm.boss.b6.phase2: Flames, rage! As my fury commands!
story.eternalrealm.boss.b6.phase3: I will burn heaven and earth alike!
story.eternalrealm.boss.b7.intro.2: BY THE ORDER OF ETERNITY, YOU WILL BE ELIMINATED.
CANNOT COMPUTE. WHY ARE BEINGS WITH ENDINGS... SO STRONG...
The crystal in the Machine God's chest shatters, and its recorded light rises to the sky.
According to the records, the End can't be destroyed. ...Someone has to become its vessel.
And what happens to the one who becomes the vessel?
...They sleep forever, holding the End inside them.
...Yes. That day, I was the one who told him.
Forgive my silence. I am Nox — the mage who traveled with Kanata a thousand years ago.
story.eternalrealm.boss.b7.phase2: DAMAGE AT FIFTY PERCENT. DEPLOYING DEFENSE UNITS.
story.eternalrealm.boss.b8.intro.2: For a thousand years I have let no one through. Nor shall I let you.
...That swordplay. The same light as his.
My name is Glaus. For a thousand years, I have guarded this gate.
Glaus...! Enough. You can rest now.
Nox, is it. ...You never did age, did you.
Light rises from the last crystal, and a distant memory appears atop the tower.
It's the fourteenth night. ...The Star Gate is opening.
I'm sorry, Elmina. ...I'm not going home.
If someone has to be the vessel, it'll be me. This is my world now.
The King... Kanata... I leave him to you. Give him his ending.
story.eternalrealm.boss.b8.phase2: Gate, seal thyself. ...I will let no one through.
story.eternalrealm.boss.final.intro.1: So you have come, children of another world who refuse the End.
story.eternalrealm.boss.final.intro.2: I am the End. The last page of every story.
story.eternalrealm.boss.final.intro.3: The name of this vessel, I have long forgotten.
story.eternalrealm.boss.final.defeat.1: ...The End comes round again, children of another world...
story.eternalrealm.boss.final.first_defe: The darkness that filled the throne room begins to crumble away with a roar.
story.eternalrealm.final.phase1.1: The King of the End rises from his throne.
story.eternalrealm.final.phase2.1: The light wanes. Stars, memories, names — all of it.
story.eternalrealm.final.phase2.2: The eclipse begins. One by one, the stars go out.
story.eternalrealm.final.phase3.1: Forget. Your names, your comrades, the home you would return to.
story.eternalrealm.final.phase3.2: Don't forget! I remember every one of your names!
story.eternalrealm.final.phase4.1: The vessel... is cracking... Silence... SILENCE...!
story.eternalrealm.final.phase4.2: ...Can you hear me? It's me. Kanata.
story.eternalrealm.final.phase4.3: Now! End it — and me along with it!
story.eternalrealm.epilogue.victory.1: And then came the fourteenth night.
story.eternalrealm.epilogue.victory.2: The adventurers gathered in the Hall of the Star Gate.
story.eternalrealm.epilogue.victory.3: The Star Gate is opening. ...It's time to say goodbye.
story.eternalrealm.epilogue.victory.4: Take care! And pay your tab next time you're here!
story.eternalrealm.epilogue.victory.5: It's what Kanata asked of you. ...Go home.
story.eternalrealm.epilogue.victory.6: I will never forget these fourteen days.
story.eternalrealm.epilogue.victory.8: In the light, the adventurers' fourteen days drew to a close.
story.eternalrealm.epilogue.victory.9: Deep in the ruins of the sky, the Eternity Engine — long thought still — creaks faintly.
story.eternalrealm.epilogue.victory.10: ...So it isn't over after all. The next cycle begins to turn.
story.eternalrealm.epilogue.victory.11: The black moon will rise again. And when it does, the Star Gate will call to you once more.
story.eternalrealm.epilogue.unfinished.1: The fourteenth night. The black moon is full.
story.eternalrealm.epilogue.unfinished.2: Because you fought, the King of the End has not fully awakened.
story.eternalrealm.epilogue.unfinished.3: I will seal the tower with all the power left to the royal line.
story.eternalrealm.epilogue.unfinished.4: The seal will hold only until the next black moon. ...Grow stronger before then.
story.eternalrealm.epilogue.unfinished.5: Safe travels. ...Next time, let's greet the dawn together.
story.eternalrealm.epilogue.unfinished.6: The black moon will rise again. The Star Gate will call to you once more.
story.eternalrealm.day.1.1: A black new moon has risen above the Tower of the End.
story.eternalrealm.day.1.2: Please, lend this world your strength.
story.eternalrealm.day.2.1: Morning bells ring out across the capital.
story.eternalrealm.day.3.1: The stars are turning fast. I won't say hurry — but don't stand still.
story.eternalrealm.day.4.1: A dry wind carries the faint scent of sand.
story.eternalrealm.day.4.2: Requests are piling up again today! Let's give it our all!
story.eternalrealm.day.5.1: Last night the black moon looked a little larger. ...But we won't lose.
story.eternalrealm.day.6.1: Out-of-season snow clouds hang over a distant sky.
story.eternalrealm.day.6.2: If you're heading somewhere cold, put something in your belly first.
story.eternalrealm.day.7.1: The black moon is half full.
story.eternalrealm.day.7.2: We're halfway. Don't rush. ...Those who rush are the first to lose their way.
story.eternalrealm.day.8.1: A distant mountain burns red, and a dragon's roar rides the wind.
story.eternalrealm.day.8.2: The letters got singed by sparks! Where did those even come from?
story.eternalrealm.day.9.1: The children of the capital have started playing at being you, you know.
story.eternalrealm.day.10.1: In the daytime sky, the faint shadow of a floating continent can be seen.
story.eternalrealm.day.10.2: The city in the sky... I left something behind up there.
story.eternalrealm.day.11.1: You look worn out. Eat something good today and get to bed early.
story.eternalrealm.day.12.1: A sound like a heartbeat begins to echo from the Tower of the End.
story.eternalrealm.day.12.2: I'd be lying if I said I wasn't afraid. But... you're here.
story.eternalrealm.day.eve.1: Tomorrow night, the black moon will be full.
story.eternalrealm.day.eve.2: It's the eve. ...Spend it with no regrets.
story.eternalrealm.day.final.1: The morning of the black full moon. Tonight comes the Hour of the End.
story.eternalrealm.day.final.2: Let's go. Let's change the fate of the world.
story.eternalrealm.day.extra.1: The black moon, nearly full, lingers in the sky.
story.eternalrealm.day.extra.2: The stars have lost their rhythm. ...There is still time.
story.eternalrealm.day.peace.1: A gentle sun rises in a sky without a black moon.
story.eternalrealm.day.peace.2: Good morning! Where will your adventures take you today?
story.eternalrealm.day.farewell.1: The morning of the fourteenth day. Tonight, the Star Gate opens.
story.eternalrealm.day.farewell.2: It's your last day. ...Enjoy it to the fullest.
story.eternalrealm.ending.1: The black mist unravels from the King of the End.
story.eternalrealm.ending.2: From within the mist emerges a lone boy.
story.eternalrealm.ending.4: My first fresh air in a thousand years. ...Tastes better than I remembered.
story.eternalrealm.ending.5: Kanata...! You complete and utter fool...!
story.eternalrealm.ending.6: Nox? A thousand years, and you haven't changed a bit.
story.eternalrealm.ending.7: Because you never came back. ...I got tired of waiting.
story.eternalrealm.ending.8: Heroes from another world. I have one favor to ask.
story.eternalrealm.ending.9: When the fourteenth night comes, go home. Don't end up like me.
story.eternalrealm.ending.10: Elmina... I kept you waiting far too long. I'm coming home now.
story.eternalrealm.ending.11: The boy smiles, and melts into the starlight.
story.eternalrealm.ending.12: The tower crumbles. The black moon shatters.
story.eternalrealm.ending.13: For the first time in a thousand years, a true dawn rises over Astoria.
story.eternalrealm.ending.14: Everyone...! Thank you — truly, thank you so much!
story.eternalrealm.ending.15: Tonight we feast! Open every barrel in the kingdom!
story.eternalrealm.ending.16: All guild tabs are cleared! ...Just for today!
story.eternalrealm.ending.19: On the fourteenth night, the Star Gate will open. Until then, please...
story.eternalrealm.ending.20: ...enjoy this world to your heart's content.
story.eternalrealm.ending.21: Thank you, heroes from another world.
story.eternalrealm.staff.title: ETERNAL REALM
story.eternalrealm.staff.subtitle: Cycle One: The King of the End
story.eternalrealm.staff.gustav: Gustav — Guildmaster of the Adventurers' Guild
story.eternalrealm.staff.adel: Adel — Captain of the Arcelian Knights
story.eternalrealm.staff.ordo: Ordo — Machine God of the Sky
story.eternalrealm.staff.travelers_list: Neris, Khalid, Helga, Ilsa, Selene, Günter
story.eternalrealm.staff.townsfolk2: Chico & Kururu, Marta, Gant, Zain, Chloe
story.eternalrealm.staff.heroes: And the adventurers who ran through these fourteen days
story.eternalrealm.staff.thanks_all: Every companion you met on this server
story.eternalrealm.staff.end: Thank you. See you in the next fourteen days.
story.eternalrealm.npc.quest_board.0.1: Welcome to the Adventurers' Guild! The knight captain told us all about you.
story.eternalrealm.npc.quest_board.0.2: The gate warden at the warp gate will take you to the Underground City!
story.eternalrealm.npc.quest_board.1.1: Great work on the Bandit King! Next up is the Moonshadow Forest.
story.eternalrealm.npc.quest_board.1.2: Please pay a visit to Neris, the sage of the forest.
story.eternalrealm.npc.quest_board.2.1: A call for help just came in from Khalid, the caravan master at the Ironvein Mine!
story.eternalrealm.npc.quest_board.3.1: Chieftain Helga of the Nordia folk at the Sacred Falls is waiting for adventurers.
story.eternalrealm.npc.quest_board.3.2: ...The guildmaster's been a little down lately, though.
story.eternalrealm.npc.quest_board.4.1: Mr. Wolfram is resting in the guild infirmary. Next is the Frozen Castle!
story.eternalrealm.npc.quest_board.5.1: There's a request from Ilsa the dragonsmith at the Ancient Ruins. Don't forget fire protection!
story.eternalrealm.npc.quest_board.6.1: The Soaring Peaks! I'd love to walk on the clouds, just once.
story.eternalrealm.npc.quest_board.7.1: The Tower of the End, at last. ...Promise me you'll come back.
story.eternalrealm.npc.quest_board.8.1: Now recruiting for the final raid! Take it on with ten or more!
story.eternalrealm.npc.quest_board.9.1: The board's full of peaceful jobs now. Like finding lost cats!
story.eternalrealm.npc.item_shop.0.1: Welcome! Stock up on potions. You can't drink 'em once you've fallen!
story.eternalrealm.npc.item_shop.1.1: You beat the Bandit King? To celebrate... I'll sell to you at full price!
story.eternalrealm.npc.item_shop.2.1: The forest herbs are back, so my potions are better than ever!
story.eternalrealm.npc.item_shop.3.1: Heading north? How about some instant soup? Buy three, get one free!
story.eternalrealm.npc.item_shop.4.1: I took medicine to the people you freed. ...Payment? Not this time.
story.eternalrealm.npc.item_shop.5.1: This salve is great for burns! Even dragonfire... probably. Probably.
story.eternalrealm.npc.item_shop.6.1: They say the winds are strong on the Soaring Peaks. Tie your hat on.
story.eternalrealm.npc.item_shop.7.1: Off to the tower, then. ...Go on. Be careful out there.
story.eternalrealm.npc.item_shop.8.1: It's the final battle, right? I've put my whole stock out! ...Oh, you're still paying, though.
story.eternalrealm.npc.item_shop.9.1: Business is booming! And the world's been saved too — couldn't ask for more!
story.eternalrealm.npc.blacksmith.0.1: ...Show me your weapon. ...Hmph. Not bad. I'll keep it in shape.
story.eternalrealm.npc.blacksmith.1.1: Old iron from the Underground City. ...The smiths of old did fine work.
story.eternalrealm.npc.blacksmith.2.1: A branch of the Ancient Tree... Make a bow of it, and it won't break for a hundred years.
story.eternalrealm.npc.blacksmith.3.1: Northern cold makes iron brittle. Don't neglect your upkeep.
story.eternalrealm.npc.blacksmith.4.1: ...I'm the one who forged Wolfram's sword. Sharpened it for the first time in twenty years.
story.eternalrealm.npc.blacksmith.5.1: You met Master Ilsa? ...She still calls me "that boy," I'll bet.
story.eternalrealm.npc.blacksmith.6.1: Steel tempered in dragonfire... A smith couldn't ask for more.
story.eternalrealm.npc.blacksmith.7.1: If you're going to the tower, don't leave a single nick in your blade. ...I'll fix every one.
story.eternalrealm.npc.blacksmith.8.1: ...The last battle, then. Trust the steel I forged.
story.eternalrealm.npc.blacksmith.9.1: ...Now that there's peace, maybe I'll forge kitchen knives. ...That was a joke.
story.eternalrealm.npc.job_master.0.1: Knight, Assassin, Mage, Ranger, Priest, Spellblade! Choose your path!
story.eternalrealm.npc.job_master.1.1: You've beaten the Bandit King! But don't get cocky. Never forget the basics of dodging!
story.eternalrealm.npc.job_master.2.1: Knights protect, Priests support. Trusting your comrades with your back — that's what battle is!
story.eternalrealm.npc.job_master.3.1: Foes in the mine are quick. When you see the warning signs, move without hesitation!
story.eternalrealm.npc.job_master.4.1: Sir Wolfram! Once hailed as the finest swordsman in the kingdom. Study his swordplay well!
story.eternalrealm.npc.job_master.5.1: Dragonfire is fierce! Watch the warning signs and don't panic!
story.eternalrealm.npc.job_master.6.1: Even the mightiest foe has an opening. Stay calm and find it!
story.eternalrealm.npc.job_master.7.1: You who challenge the tower! The days you spent training will never betray you!
story.eternalrealm.npc.job_master.8.1: In a raid, roles are everything! Tanks, healers, attackers — and someone on the mechanics!
story.eternalrealm.npc.job_master.9.1: Splendid work! ...Now, time to start training the next generation!
story.eternalrealm.npc.auction.0.1: Welcome to the exchange. It's the market that sets the prices, not me.
story.eternalrealm.npc.auction.1.1: The Bandit King's hidden treasure? Too bad — it all went back to the castle.
story.eternalrealm.npc.auction.2.1: Forest materials are hitting the market. Prices are on the move, hehe.
story.eternalrealm.npc.auction.3.1: Ancient relics dug out of the mine are fetching high prices. ...If they're genuine.
story.eternalrealm.npc.auction.4.1: Northern furs are in short supply. Too many adventurers who hate the cold.
story.eternalrealm.npc.auction.5.1: The going rate for dragon materials? Better not ask. You'll see it in your nightmares.
story.eternalrealm.npc.auction.6.1: Sky relics drive appraisers to tears. Nobody knows what they're for.
story.eternalrealm.npc.auction.7.1: No one's selling materials from the tower. Everyone still needs them.
story.eternalrealm.npc.auction.8.1: No time for trading today. ...I'm praying for you too.
story.eternalrealm.npc.auction.9.1: A special market to celebrate the peace! ...Too much profit? Your imagination, hehe.
story.eternalrealm.npc.mailbox.0.1: Got a letter? Me and my carrier pigeon Kururu will deliver it anywhere!
story.eternalrealm.npc.mailbox.1.1: With the bandits gone from underground, the delivery routes are safe again!
story.eternalrealm.npc.mailbox.2.1: Lots of thank-you letters have come in from the forest villages!
story.eternalrealm.npc.mailbox.3.1: Deliveries to the mine are... well, Kururu is scared of the shafts and won't fly.
story.eternalrealm.npc.mailbox.4.1: I'm carrying letters from the people freed from the prison to their families!
story.eternalrealm.npc.mailbox.5.1: A letter from the north! It says, "Flowers bloomed for the first time in a thousand years!"
story.eternalrealm.npc.mailbox.6.1: A letter to the Soaring Peaks? ...That's too high even for you, huh, Kururu?
story.eternalrealm.npc.mailbox.7.1: So many letters from families have arrived for the people heading to the tower.
story.eternalrealm.npc.mailbox.8.1: Letters cheering on the adventurers, from everyone in the capital!
story.eternalrealm.npc.mailbox.9.1: "Thank you" letters from all over the world! I can't deliver them all!
story.eternalrealm.npc.guild_registrar.0: Founding a guild? Submit three copies of the application, and leave no field blank.
story.eternalrealm.npc.guild_registrar.1: Report on the Bandit King's defeat: accepted. ...Your handwriting is atrocious.
story.eternalrealm.npc.guild_registrar.2: More new guilds every day. Please watch out for duplicate names.
story.eternalrealm.npc.guild_registrar.3: Cult recruitment is not permitted. Writing "Twilight" on the form won't get it through.
story.eternalrealm.npc.guild_registrar.4: Mr. Wolfram's registration was still on file from twenty years ago. I'll renew it.
story.eternalrealm.npc.guild_registrar.5: Competition between guilds is heating up. Rest assured, the rankings are tallied fairly.
story.eternalrealm.npc.guild_registrar.6: An exploration permit for the Soaring Peaks? No such form exists... I just made one.
story.eternalrealm.npc.guild_registrar.7: The roster of guilds challenging the tower. ...I'm leaving the "returned" box open for every name.
story.eternalrealm.npc.guild_registrar.8: Final raid registration is open. Just for today, one copy will do.
story.eternalrealm.npc.guild_registrar.9: The record of the guilds who saved the world... I will write the fair copy myself. Carefully.
story.eternalrealm.npc.gatekeeper.0.1: I'm Gant, keeper of the warp gate. The dungeons are through here. ...Come back alive.
story.eternalrealm.npc.gatekeeper.1.1: The bandits' den has gone quiet. ...Good to have you back.
story.eternalrealm.npc.gatekeeper.2.1: The forest labyrinth is easy to get lost in. Don't rush.
story.eternalrealm.npc.gatekeeper.3.1: The temple sand will trip you up. Watch your footing.
story.eternalrealm.npc.gatekeeper.4.1: So you're the ones who unlocked that prison. ...Good work.
story.eternalrealm.npc.gatekeeper.5.1: A spring wind is blowing in from the north. ...First time I've felt one in all my years at this gate.
story.eternalrealm.npc.gatekeeper.6.1: The gate to the sky ruins sounds like the wind. ...A strange gate.
story.eternalrealm.npc.gatekeeper.7.1: The gate to the tower glows black. ...Are you ready?
story.eternalrealm.npc.gatekeeper.8.1: This is the gate to the throne. Go with ten or more. ...And all of you come back.
story.eternalrealm.npc.gatekeeper.9.1: Welcome home. ...Every last one of you made it back.
story.eternalrealm.npc.arena_master.0.1: Welcome to the arena! Show-offs are always welcome! Injuries are on you, though!
story.eternalrealm.npc.arena_master.1.1: Someone beat the Bandit King? I'd love to get them in my arena!
story.eternalrealm.npc.arena_master.2.1: Folks back from the forest move like willows. Makes for a great match!
story.eternalrealm.npc.arena_master.3.1: You can always spot the ones back from the mine — soot on their faces! Kidding, gahaha!
story.eternalrealm.npc.arena_master.4.1: Wolfram the Silver Wolf is back!? He was the arena champion twenty years ago!
story.eternalrealm.npc.arena_master.5.1: Hey, you lot who beat the queen — how about an exhibition match here?
story.eternalrealm.npc.arena_master.6.1: Next to the ones who fought the Dragon King, my toughest fighters are kittens!
story.eternalrealm.npc.arena_master.7.1: Heroes back from the sky! Hey, give me your autograph!
story.eternalrealm.npc.arena_master.8.1: Who can hold matches on the day of the final battle!? I'm going to go cheer!
story.eternalrealm.npc.arena_master.9.1: A victory tournament! Heroes who saved the world, go all out against each other!
story.eternalrealm.npc.hall_of_fame.0.1: Welcome to the Hall of Heroes. The names of every generation's heroes are kept here.
story.eternalrealm.npc.hall_of_fame.1.1: The defeat of the Bandit King has been duly recorded.
story.eternalrealm.npc.hall_of_fame.2.1: How strange. I feel as though I've written this very record before.
story.eternalrealm.npc.hall_of_fame.3.1: An old record speaks of "the heroes of fourteen days." Could that mean you?
story.eternalrealm.npc.hall_of_fame.4.1: Records do not fade. Even if the world forgets, they remain here.
story.eternalrealm.npc.hall_of_fame.5.1: There's a blank page in the records from a thousand years ago: what became of the first hero.
story.eternalrealm.npc.hall_of_fame.6.1: Words have appeared on the blank page: "The hero did not return"...
story.eternalrealm.npc.hall_of_fame.7.1: I can read the rest of the page now: "The hero sleeps upon the tower's throne, with the End."
story.eternalrealm.npc.hall_of_fame.8.1: Please, let me finish this record. ...The record of your return.
story.eternalrealm.npc.hall_of_fame.9.1: At the end of that once-blank page, I added: "Here rests the first hero."
story.eternalrealm.npc.hall_of_fame.9.2: When the next heroes come, I'll tell them about you.
story.eternalrealm.npc.lilia.0.1: Thank you for coming. ...And I'm sorry for dragging you into this.
story.eternalrealm.npc.lilia.0.2: If there's anything I can do, please just ask.
story.eternalrealm.npc.lilia.1.1: You recovered Father's crown... He wept for joy.
story.eternalrealm.npc.lilia.1.2: That priestess in the sky... she may be my ancestor.
story.eternalrealm.npc.lilia.2.1: I-I'm Lili! Just an ordinary adventurer! Not a princess!
story.eternalrealm.npc.lilia.2.2: ...Wait, you can tell? But I'm wearing glasses...
story.eternalrealm.npc.lilia.3.1: I found the name of Priestess Elmina in an old royal diary.
story.eternalrealm.npc.lilia.3.2: She seems to have cared for the first hero very deeply.
story.eternalrealm.npc.lilia.4.1: Adel's father has come home... I'm so, so glad.
story.eternalrealm.npc.lilia.4.2: It's a wonderful thing, when someone dear comes home.
story.eternalrealm.npc.lilia.5.1: I heard spring has come to Nordia. ...The queen can finally rest.
story.eternalrealm.npc.lilia.6.1: Lili the adventurer, reporting for duty! ...Huh? You can tell again?
story.eternalrealm.npc.lilia.6.2: Flying to the sky on a dragon... I'm a little jealous.
story.eternalrealm.npc.lilia.7.1: Master Nox, from a thousand years ago... But he's still our Master Nox.
story.eternalrealm.npc.lilia.7.2: So the first hero never made it home. His promise to Elmina...
story.eternalrealm.npc.lilia.8.2: And you — you must come back. ...It's a promise.
story.eternalrealm.npc.lilia.9.1: Thank you, truly, for saving this world.
story.eternalrealm.npc.lilia.9.2: Until the Star Gate opens, please enjoy this world.
story.eternalrealm.npc.gustav.0.1: Hey, fresh faces! I'm Gustav, the guildmaster!
story.eternalrealm.npc.gustav.0.2: Met Adel yet? She used to be such a crybaby... Oops, keep that between us.
story.eternalrealm.npc.gustav.1.1: I've put that Bandit King to work washing dishes at the guild! Until he pays off his debt!
story.eternalrealm.npc.gustav.2.1: Gahaha! Not bad at all! Tonight we celebrate with my special stew!
story.eternalrealm.npc.gustav.3.1: If you're going north, I've a favor to ask. Find a man called Wolfram the Silver Wolf.
story.eternalrealm.npc.gustav.3.2: My old partner. Went north twenty years ago and never came back. ...He's Adel's father.
story.eternalrealm.npc.gustav.4.2: Twenty years of lectures can wait till he wakes up. ...Damn dust in my eye.
story.eternalrealm.npc.gustav.5.1: Wolf's awake! First words out of his mouth: "Is the stew still awful?"
story.eternalrealm.npc.gustav.6.1: Dragon mountain, eh. When we were young, Wolf and I stepped on a dragon's tail and ran for our lives.
story.eternalrealm.npc.gustav.7.1: The tower, then. ...The whole guild will be waiting for you to come home.
story.eternalrealm.npc.gustav.8.1: Leave the raid prep to me! Call out to each other, and nobody charges in alone!
story.eternalrealm.npc.gustav.8.2: ...Everyone comes back. That's a guildmaster's order.
story.eternalrealm.npc.gustav.9.1: Gahaha! Party time! Unlimited stew refills today!
story.eternalrealm.npc.nox.0.1: I'm Nox. If you have no business here, leave. ...Unless you've brought sweets.
story.eternalrealm.npc.nox.0.2: The black crystals scattered across the land... they're the key. Remember that.
story.eternalrealm.npc.nox.1.1: What the crystal held was a scene from a thousand years ago. ...We call it a Star Memory.
story.eternalrealm.npc.nox.1.2: That boy's face... I... No. It's nothing.
story.eternalrealm.npc.nox.2.1: The oath of four, hm. ...An oath weighs heaviest once it's been broken.
story.eternalrealm.npc.nox.3.1: The voice the cult heard... "End it," was it.
story.eternalrealm.npc.nox.4.1: So the Silver Wolf was saved. ...Take back whatever can still be taken back.
story.eternalrealm.npc.nox.5.1: The Ice Queen... I never did manage to thank her.
story.eternalrealm.npc.nox.6.1: The city in the sky... I left something behind up there.
story.eternalrealm.npc.nox.7.1: Forgive me for hiding it. I am Nox — the mage who journeyed with Kanata a thousand years ago.
story.eternalrealm.npc.nox.7.2: I stopped my own time with a fragment of the Eternity Engine. ...To find a way to save him.
story.eternalrealm.npc.nox.8.1: Kanata wants his ending. ...Give it to him.
story.eternalrealm.npc.nox.8.2: And tell him something for me: Nox still has a sweet tooth.
story.eternalrealm.npc.nox.9.1: ...Thank you. For the first time in a thousand years, I think I'll sleep well.
story.eternalrealm.npc.nox.9.2: But the Eternity Engine still hasn't stopped. ...That story will have to wait for another time.
story.eternalrealm.npc.laszlo.1.1: Hey there, heroes. As you can see, I'm washing dishes.
story.eternalrealm.npc.laszlo.1.2: Beats a cell. The food's good. ...Except the stew.
story.eternalrealm.npc.laszlo.2.1: You beat the forest guardian too? I was an idiot to pick a fight with you lot.
story.eternalrealm.npc.laszlo.3.1: The Order of Twilight? They tried to recruit me too. "The End is salvation," they said.
story.eternalrealm.npc.laszlo.3.2: No thanks. I want to live and drink better booze.
story.eternalrealm.npc.laszlo.4.1: Wolfram the Silver Wolf!? I tried to pick his pocket once. Biggest mistake of my life.
story.eternalrealm.npc.laszlo.5.1: My dishwashing's gotten good. ...Might be better at it than thieving.
story.eternalrealm.npc.laszlo.6.1: The Dragon King's hoard? ...N-no, I'm not after it. I've washed my hands of all that. Along with the dishes.
story.eternalrealm.npc.laszlo.7.1: That black crystal... Now that I think about it, I kept hearing someone crying.
story.eternalrealm.npc.laszlo.8.1: The final battle, huh. ...Land a punch for me too.
story.eternalrealm.npc.laszlo.9.1: The world's been saved, and the pile of dishes still won't shrink...
story.eternalrealm.npc.wolfram.4.1: ...Sorry. My body still won't listen to me.
story.eternalrealm.npc.wolfram.4.2: Adel is the knight captain? ...Gustav. You raised her for me.
story.eternalrealm.npc.wolfram.5.1: Her Majesty was truly kind. She bore the winter all alone.
story.eternalrealm.npc.wolfram.6.1: Gustav's stew is still terrible after twenty years. ...What a relief.
story.eternalrealm.npc.wolfram.7.1: The tower's gatekeeper... a knight who guarded his lord for a thousand years. I can't help but feel for him.
story.eternalrealm.npc.wolfram.8.1: If only I could move a little better. ...I'll push you forward from here.
story.eternalrealm.npc.wolfram.9.1: I'm heading north to see Her Majesty's spring. ...With my daughter. And Gustav.
story.eternalrealm.npc.arcelia_knight_ca: His Majesty tried to ride out in full armor again. ...Seventh time this month.
Laszlo, washing dishes at the guild? ...Master Gustav is far too soft.
You're going up the Sacred Falls to Nordia? ...My father climbed those falls twenty years ago, I'm told.
My father... came home. After twenty years.
I don't know what to say to him. ...Thank you, adventurers.
Father and Master Gustav drink until dawn every night. ...I wish they'd get some rest.
The knights stand ready for the final battle. Leave the capital's defense to us.
His Majesty is dancing at the feast. ...Please pretend you didn't see that.
story.eternalrealm.npc.elder_forest_sage: The forest's voice grows weak. Please, hurry.
The Guardian sleeps quietly once more. This time, with gentle dreams.
The forest is singing. ...I haven't heard so bright a song in three hundred years.
story.eternalrealm.npc.sandria_caravan_m: Nights at the mine get cold. Rest by the fire a while.
My sister came home. ...She sang our father's song through her tears.
Zahra said something to me: "An ending isn't salvation. It's just the end of a chapter."
Cold, isn't it? Care for a cup of fire-spirit? ...Not for children, mind.
So the executioner was that swordsman from twenty years ago. ...I'm glad he's alive.
The first spring in a thousand years. The children are naming flowers they've never seen.
The queen's castle is ringed with flowers now. ...Sleep well, Your Majesty.
story.eternalrealm.npc.dragonia_blacksmi: Without dragonfire, my forge just sits there cold. ...Hurry it up, would you.
Azrag's flame is back. Ah, what a fire. A thousand years old, that flame.
Now that it's peaceful, maybe I'll forge kitchen knives. ...Hah, I sound just like Goran.
story.eternalrealm.npc.celestia_oracle.6: Observing the stars... The black moon waxes, little by little.
story.eternalrealm.npc.celestia_oracle.7: Master Nox... is he well? I see. ...I'm glad.
story.eternalrealm.npc.celestia_oracle.9: My brother Ordo has gone dormant. I will keep reading the stars — for the next cycle.
story.eternalrealm.npc.tower_watcher.7.1: The tower's heartbeat grows stronger. I won't tell you to hurry. But be ready.
story.eternalrealm.npc.tower_watcher.8.1: Our ancestor... has come home. It took him a thousand years.
story.eternalrealm.npc.tower_watcher.9.1: Our clan's long watch ends today. ...Or perhaps only until the next cycle.
dialogue.eternalrealm.arcelia_knight_cap: You must be the adventurers from another world. I am Adel, Captain of the Arcelian Knights.
I'll get straight to it. Laszlo the Bandit King has made his nest beneath the capital.
The scoundrel stole His Majesty's crown, of all things — on his way out of his thirteenth jailbreak.
Once you've registered at the Adventurers' Guild, warm up on the monsters around the capital.
Since the black moon rose, monsters have multiplied around the capital.
Thin their numbers, and the people can sleep in peace.
Gant, the warden of the warp gate, will take you to the Lost Underground City.
It's the old capital that sank a thousand years ago. Don't get lost.
The Bandit King is in the deepest chamber. Get the crown... no — first, come back alive.
And that black stone he's said to carry... I have a bad feeling about it.
Welcome to the Moonshadow Forest. I am Neris, sage of the forest.
As you can see, the forest is withering. The Ancient Tree is sick.
The Guardian of the Ancient Tree has been my friend for three hundred years. ...Now it lets no one near.
Beasts poisoned by the black miasma are ravaging the forest.
The Ancient Tree's roots form a labyrinth deep underground.
Listen to the roots. If you lose your way, follow the light.
I saw a black crystal lodged in the Guardian's chest.
dialogue.eternalrealm.sandria_caravan_ma: Well, if it isn't the heroes from the capital! I'm Khalid, caravan master of the mine. Need a guide through the shafts? Leave it to me!
...Is what I'd like to say, but the Order of Twilight has been killing business.
They're trying to awaken something in the Temple of Sand.
Their prophet, Zahra... is my little sister.
Monsters crawling out of the temple keep attacking the caravans. Clearing the roads would be a huge help!
They say the temple was once a temple of the sea. Can you believe all this was ocean?
It's crawling with cultists. Watch yourselves.
My sister... she changed after we lost our parents to a sandstorm.
Please. Bring her back to me.
dialogue.eternalrealm.nordia_chieftain.m: Welcome, traveler. I am Helga, chieftain of the Nordia folk.
This land has been locked in winter for a thousand years. The queen of the Frozen Castle refuses the spring.
To reach the castle, you must first pass through the Frozen Prison.
Frozen dead coming down from above the falls are circling the village. Drive them off.
Those who tried to end the winter are imprisoned in the Frozen Prison.
Even the silver-haired swordsman who came twenty years ago... never returned.
They say the jailer is an executioner whose heart the queen froze.
Don't just cut him down. Set him free.
The executioner has fallen, and the way to the castle is open. ...Now, the queen's castle.
Our legends say the queen froze her own heart to protect her people.
If that's true... then she, too, deserves to be saved.
dialogue.eternalrealm.dragonia_blacksmit: Well, what have we here — fledglings. This is dragon country.
I'm Ilsa. A dragonsmith — I forge steel in the Dragon King's flame.
And lately that Dragon King's not himself. Something black is stoking his rage.
How's Goran doing in the capital? I'm the one who taught that boy to smith.
The Dragon King's rage has the mountain's monsters on edge. Calm them down for me.
The Dragon King's lair lies deep in the Scorching Volcanic Cave. Don't you forget your fire protection.
Azrag is a proud dragon. ...Wake him up for me.
One good punch and he'll come to his senses. Probably.
dialogue.eternalrealm.celestia_oracle.m6: VISITORS CONFIRMED... Excuse me. It has been a thousand years since I last spoke.
I am Selene, a star-reading oracle built by the Sky Folk.
Deep in the ruins, the Machine God Ordo guards the Eternity Engine.
Ordo is my elder unit — my brother. ...Please stop him.
The ruins' defense machines are attacking indiscriminately. Please shut them down.
The Ancient Sky Ruins were the last city of the Sky Folk.
A sad city... of people who feared endings.
There is a black crystal in Ordo's chest. His order-calculations are running wild.
...By the way, is there someone on the ground named "Nox"?
dialogue.eternalrealm.tower_watcher.m7_a: You made it. I am Günter, last of the clan that has kept watch over this tower.
A thousand years ago, our ancestor went into this tower... and never came out.
Our clan kept waiting. For a knight who never returned — for a thousand years.
dialogue.eternalrealm.tower_watcher.m7_h: The shadow-beasts welling out of the tower grow in number by the day.
Quiet the land around the tower. ...If only to open the way.
dialogue.eternalrealm.tower_watcher.m7_d: Inside, the spiral stairs go on and on. ...Keep your heart strong.
dialogue.eternalrealm.tower_watcher.m7_b: They say a gatekeeper has stood before the gate for a thousand years.
...Our ancestor's name was Glaus. Sir Glaus.
dialogue.eternalrealm.tower_watcher.m7_f: The way to the throne is open. ...From here on, go with ten or more.
The king our ancestor guarded all these years... please, let him rest.
dialogue.eternalrealm.arcelia_knight_cap: Pim the shopkeeper wants slime gel. Apparently it goes into his potions.
Not exactly a job for the knights, if you ask me...
Could you gather some spores for me? I want to brew a remedy to heal the forest.
dialogue.eternalrealm.sandria_caravan_ma: A warden's ghost haunts an old tomb buried in the sand. The caravans are too scared to go near.
dialogue.eternalrealm.nordia_chieftain.s: A yeti raided the village storehouse. ...For the third time. Teach it a lesson.
dialogue.eternalrealm.dragonia_blacksmit: Bring me some drake scales. They make for fine armor.
dialogue.eternalrealm.celestia_oracle.s6: Please gather the star fragments that fell from the sky. I wish to repair my star chart.
dialogue.eternalrealm.arcelia_knight_cap: I need someone on today's plains patrol. Don't overlook even the smallest change.
dialogue.eternalrealm.sandria_caravan_ma: Help me haul supplies again today. Deep in the shafts, a drop of water is worth a gold coin!
dialogue.eternalrealm.dragonia_blacksmit: Off into the depths under the ruins again today? Bring back any rare ore you find.
dialogue.eternalrealm.tower_watcher.dail: Will you keep watch over the tower with me again tonight? ...The nights are long, alone.

story.eternalrealm.boss.b5.phase4: Spring shall never come... My winter will not end!
story.eternalrealm.boss.b6.phase4: GRAAAH... Flames, burn me away with them!

story.eternalrealm.boss.b8.phase4: I am the gate, I am the shield. A thousand years, and still I stand!
area.eternalrealm.fertile_farm.desc: The kingdom's breadbasket of golden wheat and windmills. Lately more and more monsters raid the fields.
area.eternalrealm.lakeside.desc: A quiet lake with a green island. Marsh monsters lurk by the water, and there are rumours of a lake witch.
area.eternalrealm.wind_harbour.desc: A harbour town in the sea wind. Trading ships come and go, but pirate sails haunt the offing.
message.eternalrealm.world.world_edge: A thick mist turns you back. You cannot go any further.
npc.eternalrealm.folk.say.commoner.1: Lovely weather. Days like this, I rest by the fountain.
npc.eternalrealm.folk.say.commoner.2: Did you come through the Star Gate? Welcome to the capital!
npc.eternalrealm.folk.say.commoner.3: Mina at the guild desk was as cheerful as ever today.
npc.eternalrealm.folk.say.commoner.4: At night something glows over by the tower... Gives me chills.
npc.eternalrealm.folk.say.commoner.5: As long as the princess is well, this kingdom will be fine.
npc.eternalrealm.folk.say.merchant.1: Welcome! ...Oh, wait, my shop is over that way.
npc.eternalrealm.folk.say.merchant.2: Furs from the north went up again. Business is tough.
npc.eternalrealm.folk.say.merchant.3: Spices from the south just came into the harbour. Got to hurry!
npc.eternalrealm.folk.say.merchant.4: Adventurers are my best customers. Do drop by the market.
npc.eternalrealm.folk.say.farmer.1: The wheat came in well this year. A gift of the stars.
npc.eternalrealm.folk.say.farmer.2: If you see monsters trampling the fields, chase them off.
npc.eternalrealm.folk.say.farmer.3: Farmers rise early, you know. Yaaawn...
npc.eternalrealm.folk.say.farmer.4: Everyone in the capital loves our vegetables.
npc.eternalrealm.folk.say.sailor.1: The lake wind has turned. It'll be rough tomorrow.
npc.eternalrealm.folk.say.sailor.2: Fancy a drink at the harbour tavern? Not my treat, though.
npc.eternalrealm.folk.say.sailor.3: If you want rumours from far away, ask a sailor.
npc.eternalrealm.folk.say.sailor.4: Weigh anchor! ...Oh, right. It's my day off.
npc.eternalrealm.folk.say.noble.1: Good day. You must be one of the adventurers.
npc.eternalrealm.folk.say.noble.2: No balls at the castle for a while. These are dangerous times.
npc.eternalrealm.folk.say.noble.3: They say His Majesty put on his armour again. Oh dear.
npc.eternalrealm.folk.say.noble.4: The peace of the kingdom rests on your swords.
npc.eternalrealm.folk.say.elder.1: When I was young, that tower was still quiet.
npc.eternalrealm.folk.say.elder.2: Do you know the tale of the heroes of a thousand years ago?
npc.eternalrealm.folk.say.elder.3: Oh, my back... How I envy you young folk.
npc.eternalrealm.folk.say.elder.4: Don't be reckless. You only have one life.
npc.eternalrealm.folk.say.young.1: The master's going to yell at me! I have to hurry!
npc.eternalrealm.folk.say.young.2: My dream is to have a shop of my own someday.
npc.eternalrealm.folk.say.young.3: Master Goran's forge is amazing, isn't it...!
npc.eternalrealm.folk.say.young.4: I'm in the middle of a delivery. See you later!
npc.eternalrealm.folk.say.maid.1: The castle halls are so long, the cleaning never ends.
npc.eternalrealm.folk.say.maid.2: I'll be late for the princess's tea time!
npc.eternalrealm.folk.say.maid.3: The knight captain secretly loves sweets, you know.
npc.eternalrealm.folk.say.bard.1: I'm writing a new hero's song. Shall I put your name in?
npc.eternalrealm.folk.say.bard.2: ♪Through the gate of stars, the heroes came...
npc.eternalrealm.folk.say.bard.3: Sing at the tavern and the coins come pouring in.
npc.eternalrealm.folk.say.bard.4: The Bandit King song was a hit. He wasn't pleased, though.
npc.eternalrealm.folk.say.child.1: When I grow up, I'm going to be an adventurer too!
npc.eternalrealm.folk.say.child.2: Hey, hey, are monsters really that big?
npc.eternalrealm.folk.say.child.3: We're playing tag. Don't give me away!
npc.eternalrealm.folk.say.child.4: They say if you toss a coin in the fountain, your wish comes true!
npc.eternalrealm.folk.say.adventurer.1: Which dungeon are you tackling next? Prepare well.
npc.eternalrealm.folk.say.adventurer.2: The guild master's stew... Just don't.
npc.eternalrealm.folk.say.adventurer.3: If you form a party, decide on your roles first.
npc.eternalrealm.folk.say.adventurer.4: Watch for the warning signs. When the floor glows, get out.
npc.eternalrealm.folk.say.guard.1: All quiet. We keep the capital safe.
npc.eternalrealm.folk.say.guard.2: You may pass. ...Take care out there, adventurer.
npc.eternalrealm.folk.say.guard.3: The captain's drills are brutal. My legs ache again.
npc.eternalrealm.folk.say.guard.4: Not long until the night watch takes over.
npc.eternalrealm.folk.say.clergy.1: May the stars watch over you.
npc.eternalrealm.folk.say.clergy.2: The doors of the cathedral are always open.
npc.eternalrealm.folk.say.clergy.3: If you are hurt, do not hesitate to pray.
npc.eternalrealm.folk.say.clergy.4: I pray for the heroes of a thousand years ago, too.
npc.eternalrealm.folk.say.king.1: Ah, adventurer! Welcome! ...May I come along?
npc.eternalrealm.folk.say.king.2: I keep my armour ready at all times. At all times!
npc.eternalrealm.folk.say.king.3: Look after Lilia. She pushes herself too hard... *sniff*
npc.eternalrealm.folk.say.king.4: Adel stopped me again. I only wanted to go for a walk.

skill.eternalrealm.priest_judgment_day.d: [Ultimate] Calls judgment down from the heavens again and again; enemies are stunned and left vulnerable.
skill.eternalrealm.priest_divine_power.d: Raises magic damage and critical damage.
skill.eternalrealm.priest_purifying_flam: Purifying flames rise where you aim and keep burning enemies.
skill.eternalrealm.priest_seraph_wrath.d: Brings a seraph's wrath down ahead, launching and blinding enemies.
skill.eternalrealm.priest_avatar.desc: Raises skill power and critical chance.
[Ultimate] Three waves of light blast nearby enemies while healing allies.
skill.eternalrealm.spellblade_blade_attu: Part of your INT also powers physical attacks.
skill.eternalrealm.spellblade_rune_strik: Carves a rune into the enemy, leaving it vulnerable.
skill.eternalrealm.spellblade_spell_parr: A mana parry: briefly raises evasion and reflects damage taken.
skill.eternalrealm.spellblade_arcane_bur: Detonates mana around you, knocking enemies back and slowing them.
skill.eternalrealm.spellblade_runic_casc: Four rune-charged cuts; the last leaves the enemy vulnerable.
skill.eternalrealm.spellblade_mana_drain: A draining cut: heals you for part of the damage and restores stamina.
skill.eternalrealm.spellblade_crescent_m: Sends a crescent blade of mana that pierces enemies.
skill.eternalrealm.spellblade_mana_overf: Lower skill stamina costs and more max stamina.
skill.eternalrealm.spellblade_arcane_sto: [Ultimate] Wrapped in an arcane storm, cuts everything around you six times; the last stuns.
[Ultimate] Brings down a holy sword of light that cleaves a long line ahead.
skill.eternalrealm.spellblade_mana_blade: Steps in and cuts around you six times with blades of mana.
skill.eternalrealm.spellblade_flame_stri: A flaming cut that sets enemies alight.
skill.eternalrealm.spellblade_elemental_: Melee hits may set enemies on fire.
skill.eternalrealm.spellblade_frost_stri: A frosty cut that greatly slows.
skill.eternalrealm.spellblade_element_su: Raises magic damage and critical damage.
skill.eternalrealm.spellblade_frost_blad: For 10 s your blade carries frost: melee hits slow enemies and you take less damage.
skill.eternalrealm.spellblade_inferno_sl: A wide slash wreathed in hellfire.
Melee hits may stun the enemy.
skill.eternalrealm.spellblade_glacier_ed: Sends an icy edge along a line ahead, freezing enemies.
skill.eternalrealm.spellblade_thunder_bl: For 10 s your blade carries lightning: melee hits arc to another enemy nearby, and you move faster.
skill.eternalrealm.spellblade_frozen_tom: Seals nearby enemies in an icy tomb, stunning and freezing them.
skill.eternalrealm.spellblade_lightning_: Dashes through like lightning, stunning those you cut.
skill.eternalrealm.spellblade_storm_hear: Shorter skill cooldowns and faster movement.
skill.eternalrealm.spellblade_elemental_: [Ultimate] Fire, ice and lightning in three strikes: burns, freezes, then stuns.
skill.eternalrealm.spellblade_raijin.des: Calls the thunder god into your sword: four lightning strikes on nearby enemies, the last stuns.
skill.eternalrealm.spellblade_avatar_of_: Raises physical and magic damage; melee hits may freeze.
skill.eternalrealm.spellblade_meteor_bla: Leaps high and crashes down like a meteor with a flaming blade.
skill.eternalrealm.spellblade_warp_strik: Warps through space to close in and strike.
skill.eternalrealm.spellblade_gravity_sl: A gravity-laden cut that pulls nearby enemies in.
skill.eternalrealm.spellblade_phase_shif: Phases backwards through space and raises evasion for a while.
skill.eternalrealm.spellblade_rift_blade: Hurls a rift in space as a blade that pierces enemies.
skill.eternalrealm.spellblade_echo_slash: A cut that echoes: the same place is cut again a moment later.
skill.eternalrealm.spellblade_void_walke: A chance to evade attacks completely.
skill.eternalrealm.spellblade_dimension_: Opens a gate between dimensions where you aim that draws enemies in and hurts them.
skill.eternalrealm.spellblade_blink_assa: Blinks again and again for three cuts.
skill.eternalrealm.spellblade_chronomanc: Raises skill power and lowers stamina costs.
Stops time around you: enemies are stunned and your other skills recharge faster.
skill.eternalrealm.spellblade_eternity.d: More max stamina; deal more damage while below half HP.
skill.eternalrealm.spellblade_rewind.des: Rewinds your own time: heals, removes ailments and shortens your other cooldowns.
skill.eternalrealm.spellblade_world_cutt: [Ultimate] Two vast cuts that sever the world itself, leaving enemies vulnerable.
skill.eternalrealm.spellblade_dimensiona: Shorter cooldowns and more skill power.
skill.eternalrealm.spellblade_collapse.d: [Ultimate] Collapses space where you aim: enemies are drawn in, then crushed and stunned.
