design.eternalrealm.meadowlark_blade.lor: Forged on the hills where the larks sing: a first sword for the road.
design.eternalrealm.wayfarers_oath.lore: The name of a home to return to is engraved at its root.
design.eternalrealm.galewild_saber.lore: Left behind by the shadow that swallowed the meadow; a curved blade heavy with storm.
design.eternalrealm.pasture_cleaver.lore: A bandit chief took it from a farm; it cuts meat and bone alike.
design.eternalrealm.hillwarden_greatswor: Handed down by the hill wardens; its weight feels rooted in the earth.
design.eternalrealm.garms_maw.lore: Its edge recalls the highway scourge's fangs; its wounds are slow to close.
design.eternalrealm.undercity_kris.lore: Sharpened in secret in the dark of the canals; a blade that winds like water.
design.eternalrealm.thistle_fangs.lore: Meadow poison has soaked into their thorned tips.
design.eternalrealm.hooks_reapers.lore: The hooked pair Red-Eyed Hook used to drag his prey in.
design.eternalrealm.herdsman_pike.lore: Plain and sturdy, made to keep wolves from the flock.
design.eternalrealm.canal_partisan.lore: The broad head carried by the sluice keepers of the drowned city.
design.eternalrealm.durns_tuskspear.lore: A boar spear with Durn's tusks set on either side of the head; it stops a charge and drives it back.
design.eternalrealm.sprout_wand.lore: A living branch that is still growing, a little every day.
A light that has led many who were lost in the undercity back to the surface.
design.eternalrealm.dandelion_staff.lore: Fluff drifts with every swing, carrying the strength of the earth.
design.eternalrealm.shepherds_bow.lore: Worn smooth on the watchtower; it fits any hand.
design.eternalrealm.rogues_recurve.lore: A strongly curved bow for loosing poisoned arrows underground.
design.eternalrealm.skylark_longbow.lore: Its arrows sing like a lark climbing into the sky.
design.eternalrealm.moonleaf_blade.lore: A silver blade forged in the shape of a moonlit leaf.
design.eternalrealm.heartwood_edge.lore: Carved from the heart of the ancient tree; harder than steel.
design.eternalrealm.eclipse_moonblade.lo: A blade of the shadow the eclipse tree casts; keenest in the dark.
design.eternalrealm.thornwall_greatsword: Poison thorns run along the whole blade like a bramble hedge.
design.eternalrealm.rootbreaker.lore: A blade of stone that split the great roots barring the maze.
Its hilt looks like branches of the night woods twined together.
design.eternalrealm.silkcutter_pair.lore: Thin and keen enough to part spider silk without a sound.
design.eternalrealm.moth_wing_daggers.lo: Blades dusted with scales; those they cut go numb with poison.
design.eternalrealm.lunars_moonclaws.lor: A pair honed from the silver wolf king's claws; they shine cold on moonlit nights.
design.eternalrealm.vinewhip_spear.lore: Its head bends like a vine and drips poisonous sap.
design.eternalrealm.owl_feather_lance.lo: It reaches the foe as silently as an owl at night.
design.eternalrealm.grovewarden_glaive.l: The blade the grove wardens used to clear fallen trees from the path.
design.eternalrealm.mosslight_staff.lore: The glowing-moss staff forest witches light their paths with.
design.eternalrealm.crescent_druid_staff: Its cold power waxes and wanes with the moon.
design.eternalrealm.nebulas_starbranch.l: A branch the Elder of the Moonshade wove from gathered starlight.
design.eternalrealm.willow_shortbow.lore: A light bow made from a supple young willow.
design.eternalrealm.silverbark_bow.lore: Made from bark the moonlight turned to silver.
design.eternalrealm.belladonnas_nightsha: The dusk witch's poison has soaked into every strand of its string.
design.eternalrealm.ore_vein_sword.lore: A freshly mined vein glows amber inside the blade.
design.eternalrealm.sunscarab_khopesh.lo: A curved holy blade that once praised the sun in the temple of sand.
design.eternalrealm.vein_eaters_jointbla: A sword of the great centipede's shell, joined plate by plate; poison lingers on its leg spurs.
design.eternalrealm.pickaxe_breaker.lore: A rough greatsword reforged from a miner's pickaxe.
design.eternalrealm.coalheart_greatsword: The coal at its core flares red with every cut.
design.eternalrealm.colossal_ironvein.lo: A colossal slab of iron carved from the spine of the beast of the mine.
design.eternalrealm.ember_shivs.lore: A hot pair that seems born from the embers of a campfire.
design.eternalrealm.tombsand_fangs.lore: Curved blades with hidden poison that slept in the temple's tombs.
design.eternalrealm.cogwheel_daggers.lor: Gears taken from the mine machines and made into blades.
design.eternalrealm.minecart_pike.lore: A straight long pike hammered from rail iron.
design.eternalrealm.veined_steel_lance.l: Steel with blue veins is found only deep in the shafts.
The halberd the shaft warden used to drive off those who disturb the dead.
design.eternalrealm.geode_staff.lore: Earth crystals peek out of a split geode.
design.eternalrealm.sunpriest_sceptre.lo: The sceptre the temple priests raised in prayer to the sun.
design.eternalrealm.golem_core_rod.lore: The caged core of a stilled golem; lightning still pulses inside.
design.eternalrealm.cave_wren_bow.lore: Small enough to draw in the narrowest shaft.
design.eternalrealm.firedamp_longbow.lor: It wraps its arrows in the burning gas that gathers in mines.
design.eternalrealm.rustbones_rattle.lor: The rusted archer's bones rattle each time the string is drawn.
design.eternalrealm.rivermist_sword.lore: Morning river mist froze onto the blade and never left.
design.eternalrealm.pearlguard_blade.lor: A pilgrim's guard blade adorned with pearls of the sacred falls.
design.eternalrealm.frostcastle_rapier.l: The knights of the ice castle wore it with their oath to the queen.
design.eternalrealm.cascade_greatsword.l: Its blade steps down like a falling cascade.
design.eternalrealm.jailers_verdict.lore: The blade the jailer brought down on prisoners in the frozen dungeon.
design.eternalrealm.gouras_avalanche.lor: The tyrant of the falls called avalanches with this blade and a roar.
design.eternalrealm.icicle_pair.lore: Icicles that never melt, clutched by the frozen dead.
The tears of the falls' spirit hardened into blades.
design.eternalrealm.mistweavers_fangs.lo: Fangs of the great mist spider; poison spreads from its wounds like fog.
design.eternalrealm.whitewater_spear.lor: A ferryman's spear, used as a pole to cross the rapids.
design.eternalrealm.pilgrim_glaive.lore: Carried by pilgrims to the sacred falls to keep beasts away.
design.eternalrealm.falls_sovereign_trid: Held by the fallen keeper of the falls; it rules water and ice.
design.eternalrealm.holy_dew_staff.lore: A sphere of gathered morning dew shines with pure light.
design.eternalrealm.handmaidens_snowbell: The clear bell the queen's handmaidens rang in the frozen castle.
design.eternalrealm.ords_shellstaff.lore: A staff crowned with the falls tortoise's shell; centuries of moss hold the strength of the earth.
design.eternalrealm.heron_bow.lore: White and slender, like a heron standing in the snow.
design.eternalrealm.frozen_chain_bow.lor: A cold bow wrapped with the frozen chains of the dungeon.
design.eternalrealm.rainbow_spray_bow.lo: Said to be strung with the rainbow that hangs in the falls' spray.
design.eternalrealm.cinder_rune_sword.lo: Old letters carved in the blade flicker like embers.
A heavy single-edged blade forged from a magma vein of the volcano cave.
design.eternalrealm.agnis_idol_blade.lor: The ceremonial sword the ruin idol held to its chest; the fire letters carved in it still burn.
design.eternalrealm.ruin_guardian_slab.l: Wielded by the dragonkin guarding the ruins: a greatsword that is a stone tablet.
design.eternalrealm.amber_sun_greatsword: Sunlight sealed in amber sways deep inside the blade.
design.eternalrealm.ashen_dragonfang.lor: The unburnable fang left by the flame that scorched the ruins.
design.eternalrealm.ember_moth_blades.lo: Light and hot like the wings of moths dancing over the crater.
design.eternalrealm.salamander_tongues.l: The blades flicker like the tongues of lizards that live in fire.
design.eternalrealm.glyphcut_daggers.lor: Knives that carved the ruins' inscriptions; the letters glow faintly.
design.eternalrealm.scorchpoint_spear.lo: Its point is always hot and scorches whatever it touches.
design.eternalrealm.guardian_plate_halbe: The axe blade was made from a ruin guardian's armor plate.
design.eternalrealm.valkas_berserk_lance: The great lance the ruins' berserker swung, drunk on blood.
design.eternalrealm.kiln_staff.lore: The crater imps carry kiln fire caged in it.
design.eternalrealm.lava_oracle_staff.lo: The volcano oracle heard the earth's voice in its obsidian skull.
design.eternalrealm.scorch_eyes_gaze.lor: Set with the scorching blaze's eye; what it stares at bursts into flame.
design.eternalrealm.sunstone_bow.lore: A warm bow reinforced with stone that stores sunlight.
design.eternalrealm.flamewing_bow.lore: A bow of burning spines that recalls a dragon's wing bones.
Ruin tablets shaved thin into a bow; the letters carry lightning.
design.eternalrealm.cloudcutter.lore: The sky folk say clouds split in two when it is swung.
design.eternalrealm.skyforge_saber.lore: A curved blade carrying lightning, forged in the furnace of the sky ruins.
design.eternalrealm.alvins_oathblade.lor: The silver sword on which the soaring paladin swore to guard the sky.
design.eternalrealm.glacier_crest_claymo: A greatsword of clear ice cut from the peaks of everlasting snow.
design.eternalrealm.thunderhorn_greatswo: A sky knight's greatsword with a lightning beast's horns for a guard.
design.eternalrealm.thunderhead_greatbla: Taken from the chest of the colossus that breaks the peaks; it holds a thundercloud.
design.eternalrealm.wyvern_talon_pair.lo: A pair of honed wyvern talons; the wounds they open keep bleeding.
design.eternalrealm.sky_ruin_shards.lore: Glowing daggers split from the ruins' holy crystal.
design.eternalrealm.zephyrs_thunderplume: Zephyr the Thunderwing's flight feathers, turned to blades; lightning runs with every swing.
design.eternalrealm.summit_spear.lore: A long spear once planted on the summit instead of a flag.
design.eternalrealm.celestial_pillar_gla: A shard of the pillar that holds up the sky, cut into a crescent blade.
A copper lance made to draw lightning down.
design.eternalrealm.stormcaller_staff.lo: Small thunder always rumbles between its forked tips.
design.eternalrealm.cirrus_rod.lore: A ring staff, cold and light as the thin clouds of the high sky.
design.eternalrealm.starwell_staff.lore: It holds light drawn from the ruins' star-gazing well.
design.eternalrealm.windrider_bow.lore: The light white bow of the sky folk who ride the wind.
design.eternalrealm.tempest_recurve.lore: A lightning-charged bow that shows its worth in the storm.
design.eternalrealm.peak_snipers_horizon: The longbow the peak sniper used to strike beyond the horizon.
design.eternalrealm.hollowroot_blade.lor: A poison-drinking sword born from the rotten roots of the forest of the end.
design.eternalrealm.oblivion_edge.lore: It is said those it cuts forget they were ever cut.
design.eternalrealm.last_dusk.lore: Carried by the thing that came from the end: the color of the last dusk.
design.eternalrealm.nightmare_greatsword: A black greatsword forged from the nightmares of the knights of the end.
design.eternalrealm.towerfall_greatsword: A stone greatsword that broke the tower's wall; it holds the weight of fallen floors.
design.eternalrealm.black_knights_requie: The black knight of the end sounds this blade as a dirge for those it fells.
design.eternalrealm.shadowsilk_fangs.lor: The blades melt into darkness like silk woven from shadow.
design.eternalrealm.doomguard_shivs.lore: Worn by the tower's guards to open the throats of intruders.
Draw them and you hear the whispers of the void.
design.eternalrealm.corrupt_bark_spear.l: Its head is wrapped in rotten bark that seeps poison.
A heavy halberd that has broken the tower's gates many times.
design.eternalrealm.nihils_voidfang.lore: The fang of the drake that gnaws the void; they say it devours even the shadow of what it pierces.
design.eternalrealm.cultist_bonestaff.lo: The skull staff worshippers of the end use in their rites.
design.eternalrealm.abyssal_lantern.lore: A light kept burning in the tower's abyss that never goes out.
design.eternalrealm.xenos_ruinsceptre.lo: Raised by the herald of ruin to announce the end of the world.
design.eternalrealm.deadwood_bow.lore: A bow of poison thorns carved from the dead forest.
design.eternalrealm.end_howl_longbow.lor: Its arrows sound like the howl of the beasts of the end.
design.eternalrealm.oblivion_shard_bow.l: A cold bow lined with shards of oblivion like thorns.
design.eternalrealm.wheatstalk_sword.lor: Light and easy to handle; used to patrol the wheat fields.
design.eternalrealm.millstone_blade.lore: A heavy stone sword ground from the mill's millstone.
design.eternalrealm.harvest_moon_sabre.l: A golden curved blade forged under the full moon on the night of the harvest festival.
design.eternalrealm.plowshare_greatsword: A plow blade reforged into a greatsword that guards the fields.
design.eternalrealm.granary_gate_blade.l: A granary gate's bar turned into a sword; long and heavy.
design.eternalrealm.brutus_horncleaver.l: A greatsword made straight from the horn of Brutus the rampaging bull.
design.eternalrealm.twin_sickles.lore: Two harvest sickles taken up as weapons.
design.eternalrealm.strawman_needles.lor: Long poisoned needles that were stuck in a cursed straw doll.
design.eternalrealm.blight_harvest_scyth: Scythes of the root that withers the harvest, rusted by every life they reaped.
design.eternalrealm.pitchfork_spear.lore: The two-pronged fork the scarecrow dead never let go of.
design.eternalrealm.golden_ear_lance.lor: A festival lance shaped like a golden ear of wheat.
Swung by the harvest thieves' boss to reap whole fields at once.
design.eternalrealm.scarecrow_post.lore: An eerie staff that keeps birds and beasts away just by standing there.
design.eternalrealm.sunflower_staff.lore: A bright flower staff that always turns toward the sun.
design.eternalrealm.stroms_strawcrown.lo: The burning crowned staff the scarecrow king raises; it sets fire to all who come near the fields.
design.eternalrealm.crow_scaring_bow.lor: A bow decorated with black feathers, made to drive crows from the fields.
design.eternalrealm.cornsilk_bow.lore: Its string, twisted from corn silk, is surprisingly strong.
design.eternalrealm.bullhorn_recurve.lor: A strongly curved bow bent from bull horn.
design.eternalrealm.reedcutter.lore: A thin blade for cutting lakeside reeds; it cuts men and beasts the same.
design.eternalrealm.lake_scale_sword.lor: A blade of layered scales shed by Numel of the lakebed; it carries cold water.
design.eternalrealm.mirror_surface_blade: Sunk by the beast of the lakebed; a blade as clear as the lake's surface.
design.eternalrealm.driftwood_greatsword: A rough greatsword carved from a great tree washed onto the shore.
design.eternalrealm.marshking_greatsword: Pulled from the mud by the king of the marsh; it drips poison.
design.eternalrealm.numels_greatfin.lore: A greatsword carved from the dorsal fin of the lakebed's master; it cuts with the weight of cold water.
design.eternalrealm.minnow_knives.lore: Quick as minnows and gleaming silver.
design.eternalrealm.gel_glass_daggers.lo: Translucent poison blades of hardened marsh jelly.
design.eternalrealm.kingfisher_pair.lore: Like a kingfisher diving into the water, they catch prey in an instant.
design.eternalrealm.rusted_harpoon.lore: Still sharp beneath the rust; its barbs widen the wound.
design.eternalrealm.pearl_tide_spear.lor: The pearl on its head glows cold whenever the lake rises.
design.eternalrealm.drowned_fishers_gaff: The hook the drowned fisher still uses to haul prey from the lake.
design.eternalrealm.lotus_staff.lore: It shines pure like a lotus blooming from mud.
design.eternalrealm.lakebed_oracle.lore: Priestesses read the future reflected in the lakebed pearl.
design.eternalrealm.melusines_mirror.lor: The water mirror Melu the lake witch used to freeze the hearts of those who looked in.
design.eternalrealm.reed_bow.lore: The light bow of the lakeside folk, cored with bound reeds.
design.eternalrealm.dragonfly_bow.lore: Its dragonfly-wing ornaments are clear as glass and carry lightning.
design.eternalrealm.spirit_pearl_bow.lor: Pearls home to water spirits are set in both ends.
design.eternalrealm.deckhand_cutlass.lor: The handy curved sword pirate deckhands hang at their hips.
design.eternalrealm.doubloon_rapier.lore: A dandy's rapier with a gold coin set in the guard.
design.eternalrealm.barbas_tidecleaver.l: The single-edged blade the one-eyed captain used to cut through stormy seas.
design.eternalrealm.anchor_greatsword.lo: A tremendously heavy greatsword reforged from a ship's anchor.
design.eternalrealm.stormsail_greatsword: Like a sail catching a storm, it howls with wind and thunder when swung.
design.eternalrealm.ankaras_great_pincer: The pincer of the crab that eats anchors; it crushes even a steel anchor.
design.eternalrealm.saltspray_daggers.lo: Long exposed to the sea wind, they wear cold salt crystals.
design.eternalrealm.inkstorm_blades.lore: Blades poured with sea-monster ink; darkness scatters with every cut.
design.eternalrealm.dock_brawlers_knuckl: Bladed knuckles the dock brawler slams in along with his fists.
design.eternalrealm.boarding_pike.lore: A short, sturdy pike for boarding enemy ships.
design.eternalrealm.windlass_harpoon.lor: A copper harpoon pulled back by the ship's windlass.
design.eternalrealm.maelstrom_trident.lo: The coral trident the storm-calling sorcerer used to whirl the sea.
design.eternalrealm.buoy_lantern_staff.l: A harbour buoy light made into a staff; it does not go out on stormy nights.
design.eternalrealm.compass_rose_staff.l: A navigator's staff crowned with the star of a compass.
design.eternalrealm.kraken_ink_rod.lore: An ink orb sways at the tip of a staff curled like a tentacle.
design.eternalrealm.gunwale_bow.lore: A salt-proof bow for shooting pirates from the gunwale.
design.eternalrealm.seagull_bow.lore: White as harbour gulls; it hums lightly in the wind.
design.eternalrealm.trade_wind_longbow.l: It carries its arrows on the winds that cross far seas.
design.eternalrealm.bandit_king_twinshad: The pair the undercity's bandit king swung while trading places with his shadows.
design.eternalrealm.ancient_tree_heartst: The amber heart that beat in the chest of the ancient tree's guardian.
design.eternalrealm.colossus_dunespear.l: The earthen spear the sand colossus thrust out with the sandstorm.
design.eternalrealm.frozen_executioner_b: The ice blade the executioner of the frozen prison brought down once for every prisoner.
design.eternalrealm.frozen_queen_sceptre: The sceptre with which the frozen queen froze time along with her castle.
design.eternalrealm.dragon_king_flamebra: A king's sword in which the scorching dragon king's flame still burns.

art.eternalrealm.art_relic_b1.desc: A carefully aimed thrust that pierces straight ahead. The final hit weakens foes. You vanish and foes lose track of you. Wounds the weakened deeper.
art.eternalrealm.art_relic_b2.desc: Smashes the ground, striking every foe around you. The final hit leaves foes vulnerable. Briefly stuns the foes it hits. A lingering field of earth remains where it lands.
art.eternalrealm.art_relic_b3.desc: A heavy arrow that bursts where it hits. The final hit leaves foes vulnerable. Blinds the foes it hits. Leaves a field that slows foes.
art.eternalrealm.art_relic_b4.desc: Thrusts, then slams the ground ahead. The final hit slows foes. Wounds the weakened deeper. Marks the spot first; a second strike falls there a moment later.
art.eternalrealm.art_relic_b5.desc: Leaps in and rains six blows with both blades. The final hit slows foes. Leaves a field that slows foes. You dodge more easily during the art.
art.eternalrealm.art_relic_b6.desc: Charges forward and runs foes through. The final hit sets foes on fire. Your weapon carries fire for a while afterwards. Launches foes into the air.
art.eternalrealm.art_relic_b7.desc: Brings an all-out blow down from overhead. The final hit stuns foes. Briefly stuns the foes it hits. Marks the spot first; a second strike falls there a moment later.
art.eternalrealm.art_relic_b8.desc: Drops a bolt from above onto the target, where it bursts. The final hit weakens foes. Pulls foes in. A lingering field of darkness remains where it lands.
art.eternalrealm.art_relic_final.desc: Arrows rain down on the target. The final hit makes foes bleed. A lingering field of blood remains where it lands. For a while your hits drain health.
art.eternalrealm.art_relic_c_meadow.desc: Closes in at once and stabs a weak point deep. The final hit weakens foes. You vanish and foes lose track of you. Drains part of the damage as health.
art.eternalrealm.art_relic_c_moon_forest: Fires a mass of magic that bursts where it lands. The final hit blinds foes. Heals you and allies nearby. Cleanses allies nearby.
art.eternalrealm.art_relic_c_iron_mine.d: Cuts, then makes the ground ahead burst upward. The final hit leaves foes vulnerable. Briefly stuns the foes it hits. Knocks foes far back.
art.eternalrealm.art_relic_c_sacred_fall: One long-reaching thrust through everything in a line. The final hit slows foes. Pulls foes in. Leaves a field that slows foes.
art.eternalrealm.art_relic_c_ancient_rui: Sweeps everything around you in one burst. The final hit sets foes on fire. Your weapon carries fire for a while afterwards. A lingering field of fire remains where it lands.
art.eternalrealm.art_relic_c_soaring_pea: An arrow that keeps going through everything in its path. The final hit stuns foes. Briefly stuns the foes it hits. Raises your critical rate.
A fast, sharp bolt that pierces several foes. The final hit weakens foes. Drains part of the damage as health. Marks the spot first; a second strike falls there a moment later.
art.eternalrealm.art_relic_c_farm.desc: Slams both blades down, striking all around twice. The final hit poisons foes. A lingering field of venom remains where it lands. For a while your hits drain health.
art.eternalrealm.art_relic_c_lakeside.de: Gathers strength and cleaves down in a wide arc. The final hit slows foes. Knocks foes far back. Leaves a field that slows foes.
art.eternalrealm.art_relic_c_harbour.des: Five bolts fly out in a fan. The final hit stuns foes. Briefly stuns the foes it hits. You move faster for a while afterwards.
art.eternalrealm.art_relic_l_garm.desc: Charges forward and runs foes through. The final hit makes foes bleed. For a while your hits drain health. Knocks foes far back.
art.eternalrealm.art_relic_l_hook.desc: One fully drawn arrow that pierces far through several foes. The final hit weakens foes. Wounds the weakened deeper. Marks the spot first; a second strike falls there a moment later.
art.eternalrealm.art_relic_l_durn.desc: Two flowing cuts, finished with a spinning slash. The final hit leaves foes vulnerable. Knocks foes far back. Raises your defense.
art.eternalrealm.art_relic_l_nebula.desc: Five arrows in a fan. The final hit blinds foes. Heals you and allies nearby. Raises your critical rate.

estate.eternalrealm.room.tower.descripti: Two floors of a round tower above the capital's roofs: bed and fireplace below; up the spiral stair, the observatory with its telescope under a painted night sky, and a balcony all round.
estate.eternalrealm.room.grand.descripti: The manor's finest rooms: a salon, a bedchamber with a great four-poster, an armoury lined with stands and weapon frames, a vault behind an iron gate, and a balcony over the canal.

guildhouse.eternalrealm.design.northern_: A tarred-timber longhouse under a steep shingle roof with carved horns crossing over its gables: a long hearth between benches to the high seat, a smithy lean-to, a fenced training yard with a bell frame, a rune stone on a snowy ridge.
guildhouse.eternalrealm.design.mushroom_: The hollow stem of a giant fly agaric is the hall and its spotted cap a round loft; a workshop under a brown cap, dummies in a fairy ring by a glowing teal mushroom, spore blossoms drifting from the gills.
guildhouse.eternalrealm.design.ancient_r: A ruined temple's cella restored as the guild hall: a mosaic floor, an eternal flame, runes glowing in the walls and an oak growing through the fallen east end; a stoa workshop, a bell in a surviving arch, a lily pool.
guildhouse.eternalrealm.design.pirate_sh: A black-sailed pirate ship at anchor in a palm island's lagoon: the board, the charts and the treasure vault in the captain's cabin, chests in the hold, the jolly roger over the crow's nest; a thatched shipwright's shed and dummies on the beach.
guildhouse.eternalrealm.design.flower_gl: A white-ribbed glass palm house: a fountain jets up under the dome among palms and flower beds, an orangery and a plant room in its wings; a brick potting shed is the workshop, dummies stand in a hedged garden by a white bell.
guildhouse.eternalrealm.design.dwarven_f: A twenty-block hall carved in a mountain of seamed rock: gold-banded pillars, curtains of lava behind grilles, a forge under a great hood, a practice pit of armoured dummies, the gong, a vault behind an iron door opened by a button, a balcony on the east face.
guildhouse.eternalrealm.design.desert_pa: An oasis palace behind crenellated sandstone walls: a courtyard with a fountain pool and orange trees, horseshoe arcades, the audience hall under a golden onion dome, the treasury behind a grille, a minaret and a palm-ringed spring.
guildhouse.eternalrealm.design.observato: A midnight-blue tower banded in gold and studded with stars: an orrery on the ground floor, a chart room of shelves, a great telescope looking out of the slit in a verdigris dome; a workshop, a sundial, an armillary sphere and a bell-cote.
guildhouse.eternalrealm.design.japanese_: A shoin hall behind a white wall and a vermilion gate: a veranda, tatami rooms behind paper screens, the board in the alcove, an enchanting nook in the scroll room; a white storehouse, a dojo, a koi pond with a red bridge, a torii, bamboo and a belfry.
guildhouse.eternalrealm.design.great_tre: A guild house inside the trunk of a giant tree: a stair spirals round the trunk to the hall, the council room and the library with the enchanting nook; a workshop and a lounge on decks in the boughs, a lookout on a birch, glow berries in the canopy.
guildhouse.eternalrealm.design.sage_libr: A reading hall three galleries high, all books: long tables down the nave to the enchanting dais, a great globe in the verdigris-domed rotunda; a clock tower, the archive with the vault behind a grille, the bindery workshop, dummies in the cloister garden.
guildhouse.eternalrealm.design.jungle_te: A stepped pyramid rising from the jungle: a grand stair to the golden summit shrine with the enchanting nook, a pillared hall inside with the board and a treasury heaped with gold; thatched workshop huts, a waterfall pool, a bell in a stone arch.
guildhouse.eternalrealm.design.gothic_ca: A dark-stone cathedral of spires and flying buttresses: purple and blue glass over candle-lit pews, the board and the armour on the crossing's dais, chests in the chapels, vaults in the crypt, a workshop in the cloister walks and dummies in its garth.
guildhouse.eternalrealm.design.coral_hal: A great glass dome on the floor of the island's inland sea among coral reefs and kelp: a stair in a glass tube leads down to a prismarine palace with a shell throne and a pearl treasury; a workshop in a second bubble, dummies on the rim.
guildhouse.eternalrealm.design.volcanic_: A basalt fortress under its volcano: horned battlements, a great hall of braziers hung with trophies and armour, a forge on a lava channel, vaults in the undercroft, the enchanting nook atop the tower; lava falls from the smoking crater.
guildhouse.eternalrealm.design.ice_castl: A castle of packed and blue ice on a snowy island: four towers with icy spires, a throne hall where a blue soul fire burns under ice chandeliers, a warm timber workshop, the ice vault, dummies on the frozen lake, a frozen waterfall.
guildhouse.eternalrealm.design.dragon_la: A crag of black rock with a great dragon's bones coiled over its summit: inside, gold heaped round a dragon egg and two vaults, the guild's hall on a raised shelf, lava pools and amethyst; a sand arena outside with the bell in a bone arch.
guildhouse.eternalrealm.design.arcane_to: A sixty-block purpur tower girdled by two floating rings and crowned by a crystal spire: a spiral stair climbs past the hall, the library with the enchanting nook, the alchemy laboratory, the council chamber and the treasury to the sanctum with the bell.
guildhouse.eternalrealm.design.sky_templ: A temple of white marble and gold on islands among the clouds: a colonnaded sanctum under a golden roof with a winged guardian and a treasury beneath; arched bridges lead to a garden island with a fountain and a bell rotunda, a training island and a workshop island.
guildhouse.eternalrealm.design.marble_pa: A white marble palace under golden domes: a reflecting pool with fountains between clipped parterres, a colonnaded front, a ballroom of chandeliers, the throne room and its trophy gallery, a library with the enchanting nook, the treasury and a parade court.

traveller.eternalrealm.rosalind.farewell: That was fun. Let's meet again on a night full of stars.
traveller.eternalrealm.rosalind.down: Ah... perhaps I pushed a little too hard...
traveller.eternalrealm.rosalind.up: Hehe, sorry to worry you. I'm fine now.
traveller.eternalrealm.rosalind.field.1: The monsters are restless around here. The stars, perhaps.
traveller.eternalrealm.rosalind.field.2: I once defended this kingdom alone... That was a very long time ago.
traveller.eternalrealm.rosalind.field.3: What a lovely breeze. A perfect day to practise magic.
traveller.eternalrealm.rosalind.shop.1: I ran out of moonstone ink. Not a bad selection here.
traveller.eternalrealm.rosalind.shop.2: Even witches go shopping, you know. Surprised?
traveller.eternalrealm.rosalind.shop.3: Buying something too? Always carry a few extra potions.
traveller.eternalrealm.rosalind.inn.1: The tea here is better than you'd think. Care for a cup?
traveller.eternalrealm.rosalind.inn.2: I like to count the stars before I sleep. You can see them well from this window.
traveller.eternalrealm.rosalind.inn.3: They call me the wandering witch. Maybe I'm just lonely.
traveller.eternalrealm.rosalind.party.1: Hehe, walking with you is never dull.
traveller.eternalrealm.rosalind.party.2: If it gets dangerous, stay behind me.
traveller.eternalrealm.rosalind.party.3: Where to next? Wherever the stars lead us.
traveller.eternalrealm.rosalind.party.4: Don't overdo it... not that I'm one to talk.
traveller.eternalrealm.rosalind.shout.st: Stars, rain down upon them - Starfall!
Hold still. The stars will bind you - Constellation Chains!
traveller.eternalrealm.rosalind.shout.th: Once more, the night I guarded this land... Open, Canopy of a Thousand Nights!
traveller.eternalrealm.siegwald.title: The Knight Who Turned the Dragon
traveller.eternalrealm.siegwald.meet.1: ...An adventurer. The monsters here are on edge. Stay alert.
traveller.eternalrealm.siegwald.meet.2: My name is Siegwald. They call me the knight who turned the dragon, but I only drove it off. I could not slay it.
traveller.eternalrealm.siegwald.meet.3: I am testing how far this one iron sword can take me.
traveller.eternalrealm.siegwald.ask: I would see where your road leads. If you need a sword, I am yours.
traveller.eternalrealm.siegwald.accept: Understood. My sword is yours to command.
traveller.eternalrealm.siegwald.decline: I see. Our roads may cross again.
traveller.eternalrealm.siegwald.farewell: This is where we part. Fare you well.
traveller.eternalrealm.siegwald.down: Ngh... not yet... I cannot fall yet...
traveller.eternalrealm.siegwald.up: Forgive the wait. From here I will not give an inch.
traveller.eternalrealm.siegwald.field.1: The air is thick with monsters. Be careful.
traveller.eternalrealm.siegwald.field.2: Iron is good. If it breaks, you forge it again.
traveller.eternalrealm.siegwald.field.3: One day I must settle things with that dragon.
traveller.eternalrealm.siegwald.shop.1: I came for a whetstone. A blade must be cared for.
traveller.eternalrealm.siegwald.shop.3: Seeing to your gear as well? A good habit.
traveller.eternalrealm.siegwald.inn.1: Rest when you can. That too is a knight's duty.
traveller.eternalrealm.siegwald.inn.2: The innkeeper and I are old friends.
traveller.eternalrealm.siegwald.inn.3: When I was young, I swung my sword all night long.
traveller.eternalrealm.siegwald.party.2: Your sword grows keener by the day.
traveller.eternalrealm.siegwald.party.3: Whatever comes, I will take it on myself.
traveller.eternalrealm.siegwald.party.4: Let us go. The road is long.
traveller.eternalrealm.siegwald.shout.oa: None shall pass! - Oath of the Unmoving!
traveller.eternalrealm.siegwald.shout.wh: Come at me, all of you - Whirlwind Cleave!
traveller.eternalrealm.move.dragon_strok: The Stroke That Turned the Dragon
traveller.eternalrealm.siegwald.shout.dr: The blow that turned a dragon... take it! - The Stroke That Turned the Dragon!
traveller.eternalrealm.kaylen.title: The Spellblade Who Cleared Every Depth
traveller.eternalrealm.kaylen.meet.2: Kaylen. They call me the spellblade who cleared every depth. I've been through every EX dungeon... That's all.
traveller.eternalrealm.kaylen.meet.3: I was getting bored. You look like you might have some backbone.
traveller.eternalrealm.kaylen.ask: ...I wouldn't mind tagging along for a while. Well?
traveller.eternalrealm.kaylen.field.1: ...I'm sick of cutting things around here.
traveller.eternalrealm.kaylen.field.2: Compared to the deepest dungeons, this is a stroll.
traveller.eternalrealm.kaylen.field.3: Just killing time so my arm doesn't get dull.
traveller.eternalrealm.kaylen.shop.2: I don't use potions. ...Just one, in case.
traveller.eternalrealm.kaylen.shop.3: The shopkeeper here has a good eye.
traveller.eternalrealm.kaylen.inn.2: Every dungeon's cleared... I'm still figuring out what comes next.
traveller.eternalrealm.kaylen.inn.3: ...I wasn't asleep. My eyes were just closed.
traveller.eternalrealm.kaylen.party.2: You move better than you used to.
traveller.eternalrealm.kaylen.party.3: If something strong shows up, leave it to me.
traveller.eternalrealm.kaylen.shout.phan: Fall, phantom blades - Phantom Blade Array.
traveller.eternalrealm.kaylen.shout.infi: ...It's already cut. Realm of Endless Blades.
traveller.eternalrealm.mariel.title: The Sister Who Saved the Kingdom
traveller.eternalrealm.mariel.meet.1: Oh, a traveller. Are you hurt anywhere?
traveller.eternalrealm.mariel.meet.2: My name is Mariel. When the sickness spread through the kingdom, I helped a little. I am only a sister.
traveller.eternalrealm.mariel.meet.3: Hehe, 'the saint who saved the kingdom' is too much. The light answered because everyone wished to live.
traveller.eternalrealm.mariel.ask: Would you let my prayers walk beside you on your journey?
traveller.eternalrealm.mariel.accept: Gladly. Whatever wounds you suffer, I will heal them.
traveller.eternalrealm.mariel.decline: I understand. May light be upon your journey.
traveller.eternalrealm.mariel.farewell: So this is goodbye. I will always pray for you.
traveller.eternalrealm.mariel.down: I'm sorry... let me rest, just a little...
traveller.eternalrealm.mariel.up: I'm all right now. Come, let us go.
traveller.eternalrealm.mariel.field.1: If anyone is hurt, call me at once.
traveller.eternalrealm.mariel.field.2: The flowers, even the monsters, all are lives of this land.
traveller.eternalrealm.mariel.field.3: The sickness reached a village near here once... and now it is so peaceful.
traveller.eternalrealm.mariel.shop.1: A few herbs. I brew them for the children at the church.
traveller.eternalrealm.mariel.shop.2: Oh dear, I bought far too much again.
traveller.eternalrealm.mariel.shop.3: I get my prayer candles here too.
traveller.eternalrealm.mariel.inn.1: Would you like some warm soup? It will give you strength.
traveller.eternalrealm.mariel.inn.2: Every night I pray for everyone in the kingdom before I sleep.
traveller.eternalrealm.mariel.party.1: Are you hurt? I can heal you anytime.
traveller.eternalrealm.mariel.party.2: I feel so much braver with you.
traveller.eternalrealm.mariel.party.3: If you're tired, let's rest a little.
traveller.eternalrealm.mariel.party.4: The light is always with you.
traveller.eternalrealm.mariel.shout.sanc: Light, heal them all - Sanctuary of Healing!
traveller.eternalrealm.mariel.shout.puri: Cleanse this corruption - Pillars of Purification!
traveller.eternalrealm.mariel.shout.king: Please, just once more... a miracle. Prayer of the Kingdom Reborn!
